evidence.title: Huemint - Generate a unique 3-accent palette for your website
Huemint - About Huemint - Machine learning for graphic design colorization

name: Huemint
summary: Machine-learning colour palette generator that assigns colours by how each one is used in a design.
description: Huemint generates colour schemes for brands, websites, gradients and illustrations with a machine-learning model that knows which colours are background, foreground and accent. Templates cover brand, website, gradient, illustration and Bootstrap layouts; swatches can be locked, colours copied as code, or extracted from an uploaded flat-design image.
contains: templates: brand, website, gradient, illustration, Bootstrap
lock swatches and regenerate around them
upload a flat design image to extract its colour structure
three models: random baseline, transformer, diffusion
trained on 1.2 million filtered design images
copy code and copy link, simple and advanced modes
